title: Broadcast of incorrect bgvalues when scanning manually
body:
When scanning the FSL manually with xDrip only the 4 latest values get broadcasted correctly (like to AAPS), values that are older than that will default to the latest value. 

The first two screenshots show xDrip and AAPS before scanning, the others are after scanning.
